question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Indian society is a complex mix of ______ cultures, people and languages.
solution: The correct answer is: **diverse**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Diverse**: The term '**diverse**' in the given context denotes variety or showing a great deal of variety. (विविधता पूर्ण) • The sentence "*Indian society is a complex mix of **diverse **__cultures, people and languages*" means that Indian society is composed of a wide variety of cultures, people, and languages. • Hence, the correct word to fill in the blank is '**diverse**'. Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Diversity**: A range of different things. (विभिन्न चीजों की एक श्रृंखला) • **Diverges**: To differ in opinion, character, form or other quality. (राय, चरित्र, रूप या अन्य गुणवत्ता में भिन्नता होना) • **Diversion**: Something that turns your attention off of what you are thinking about or doing. (कुछ ऐसा जो आपका ध्यान इस ओर से हटा देता है कि आप क्या सोच रहे हैं या क्या कर रहे हैं) 3c:T5e2, The correct answer is "**Treacherous person**".
